content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?Modlites NSW's PostModlites NSWMarch 30 at 8:40 PM · Shared with Public FROM — Season 4 (2026) Starring: Harold Perrineau • Catalina Sandino Moreno • Eion Bailey Psychological Horror • Mystery • Drama “You’re not trapped in the town… you’re part of it.”FROM — Season 4 (2026) pushes deeper into the psychological terror of the town, where survival is no longer just physical—it’s mental, emotional, and existential. As fragments of truth begin to surface, the mystery evolves into something far more unsettling: the possibility that the town itself is shaping those within it.Harold Perrineau returns as Boyd Stevens, a leader stretched to his breaking point, forced to make choices where no outcome is truly a victory. Catalina Sandino Moreno continues as Tabitha Matthews, uncovering disturbing clues that hint the town is more than a location—it’s a force with intent. Eion Bailey portrays Jim Matthews, holding onto logic in a reality that increasingly defies it. A town that observes, adapts, and manipulates Fear and memory weaponized against its victims Trust eroding as paranoia spreads Creatures evolving with unsettling intelligenceAs the community fractures, the danger shifts inward. Secrets, guilt, and past decisions begin to surface, turning survivors against each other.
